claims.originating_goal: Correct My KV Step 2 so a registered Node with no prior KnowledgeVault relationship remains explicitly KV_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_ESTABLISHED and cannot be mistaken for an established but unverified KV installation.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release only after PR #1450 exact-head Site validation passes, the implementation is merged, README and handoff are current, and a claim terminalization records merge evidence.
expected_evidence: fresh empty DEVICE_KV store returns KV_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_ESTABLISHED
fresh state has kv_relationship_established=false and resident_kv_root_observed=false
installation receipt recovery stays hidden until existing-KV path selection or authentic relationship evidence
verified and established-but-unverified KV states remain fail-closed and distinct
collision_boundaries: Do not create a second KV or InTr runtime
Do not infer a KV relationship from Node registration or MY_KV_ONBOARDING_STEP_1_COMPLETED
Do not expose existing-KV receipt recovery before explicit existing-KV selection or relationship evidence
No provider credentials or secret material in Site state
claims.next_task_after_release: Observe the propagated Step 2 behavior on a genuinely fresh registered Node and require KV_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_ESTABLISHED before any create/connect choice is made.
